name: Image-to-Voxel Heightmap Generation
definition: Converts a 2D image into a 3D voxel structure where pixel intensity determines voxel height along the Y-axis. Supports standard vertical extrusion and an 'excavate' mode that clips voxel columns to the minimum height of their 4-connected neighbors.
summary: Image-to-Voxel Heightmap Generation converts 2D images into 3D voxel structures by mapping pixel intensity to height, distinguished by an excavate mode that clips columns to prevent overhangs.
